hubs.BookingService: Central aggregate. Almost every operational domain hangs off it.
hubs.User: Central actor. Referenced by 30+ models, directly or via staff extensions.
hubs.Technician: Central resource. Owns availability, assignments, stock custody and payroll inputs.
hubs.Tool: Resource hub for every field-consumable movement.
hubs.Payment: Financial hub with four unconstrained parents.
